component.name: stitch
component.title: Stitch
component.description: Send batches of records to the Stitch Import API, which loads them into a table of the destination data warehouse.
component.label: cloud,api,saas,bigdata

configuration.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints. Each endpoint gets a copy, and the options and the table name of the endpoint URI override its values.

keyNames.label: producer
keyNames.description: The Primary Key fields of the source table, as a comma separated list without spaces. Stitch uses them to de-duplicate the records when it loads them, and loads the table append-only when there are none. The CamelStitchKeyNames header overrides it, and the names are added to the key_names of a StitchRequestBody or Map body.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

region.label: producer
region.description: The region of the Stitch account, which selects the host of the Import API: EUROPE (api.eu-central-1.stitchdata.com) or NORTH_AMERICA (api.stitchdata.com). Not used when stitchClient is set.

stitchSchema.label: producer
stitchSchema.description: The JSON schema that describes the records of the batch; Stitch rejects records that do not conform to it. The CamelStitchSchema header overrides it, and it overrides the schema of a StitchRequestBody or Map body.

connectionProvider.label: producer,advanced
connectionProvider.description: A Reactor Netty ConnectionProvider, for example a pool with a maximum number of connections, that the endpoint creates its HttpClient with. Not used when httpClient or stitchClient is set.

httpClient.label: producer,advanced
httpClient.description: A custom Reactor Netty HttpClient that sends the requests. The endpoint still sets the host of the region and the Authorization and Content-Type headers on it, and does not use connectionProvider. Not used when stitchClient is set.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

stitchClient.label: advanced
stitchClient.description: A custom implementation of the org.apache.camel.component.stitch.client.StitchClient interface that sends the batches. When set, the region, httpClient and connectionProvider options are not used, and the endpoint does not close the client when it stops.

token.label: security
token.description: The access token of the Stitch Import API, sent as a Bearer token. It is required, also when stitchClient is set.

CamelStitchTableName.label: producer
CamelStitchTableName.description: The name of the destination table that the records are loaded into. It overrides the table name of the endpoint URI.

CamelStitchSchema.label: producer
CamelStitchSchema.description: The JSON schema that describes the records, as a StitchSchema or as a Map of JSON schema keywords. It overrides the stitchSchema option; a value of another type is ignored.

CamelStitchKeyNames.label: producer
CamelStitchKeyNames.description: The Primary Key fields of the source table, as a comma separated String without spaces. It overrides the keyNames option.

CamelStitchCode.label: producer
CamelStitchCode.description: The HTTP status code of the response of the Stitch Import API. Set only when the request succeeds: a status code of 300 or more fails the exchange with a StitchException.

CamelStitchHeaders.label: producer
CamelStitchHeaders.description: The HTTP headers of the response of the Stitch Import API, by header name. Set only when the request succeeds.

CamelStitchStatus.label: producer
CamelStitchStatus.description: The status field of the JSON response of the Stitch Import API, empty when the response has none. Set only when the request succeeds.

producerIn.description: A StitchRequestBody, a StitchMessage, a Map of the Stitch batch JSON (table_name, schema, messages, key_names as a list or a comma separated String), or a List of StitchMessage, Map of a message, StitchRequestBody, Message or Exchange. Text, bytes, a stream or no body fails. The tableName, keyNames and schema options or headers set the rest of the batch

producerOut.description: The message of the response of Stitch, empty when it has none; the HTTP status code, the status and the response headers are in the CamelStitchCode, CamelStitchStatus and CamelStitchHeaders headers

tableName.description: The name of the destination table that the records are loaded into. The CamelStitchTableName header overrides it, and it overrides the table_name of a StitchRequestBody or Map body. Table names must be unique in each destination schema, and Stitch rejects the data when the name is longer than the destination allows.
